name: autoref
description: Convert DOCX citations into Zotero fields and figure/table mentions into Word cross-references.

interface.longDescription: Analyze research papers, convert safe citation matches to native Zotero Word fields, create native Word cross-references for figure/table mentions, export CSL-JSON, and optionally create linked Zotero items after review.
defaultPrompt: Convert my DOCX citations for Zotero.
Create Word cross-references for figures and tables in my DOCX.
Preview a linked Zotero library import.
